changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE sensitive_word ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, word VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_sensitive_word (word) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT = '敏感词';
